title: fix(runtime): save_metadata_draft's clientSpecVersion example names the server's own spec version
body:
Fixes #37755

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：智能体通过 MCP 保存元数据草稿时，工具说明和格式错误提示里的版本号示例，从写死的 18.6.0 变成服务端自己的版本号。
- 为什么做：属于 MCP 智能体编写能力；服务端已是 19，智能体照抄旧示例会被当作跨大版本而拒绝保存。
- 出错会怎样：只影响一句说明文字，版本判定逻辑不变；有问题可直接撤回这个改动。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts`: a new `specVersionExample()` builds the SemVer example from `SERVER_SPEC_VERSION`. Both agent-facing strings now use it: the `clientSpecVersion` parameter description of `save_metadata_draft`, and the refusal for a value that is not in SemVer form (`clientSpecVersionVerdict`, which passes its own `server` argument through). When the server cannot read its own spec version, the text names the form (`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`) and does not make up a number. The verdict logic is unchanged.
- One changeset, `@objectstack/runtime` patch.

Sweep of hard-coded `18.6.0` under `packages/**` and `skills/**` (origin/main cac93cc6): the two strings above were the only spec-version *examples* that teach an agent a value to declare. The other hits are history or test data, and none needs a change:
- `packages/spec/src/automation/webhook.zod.ts` and its test: "removed in 18.6.0", a historical fact.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/**`: `retiredAfter: '18.6.0'`, conversion schedule data.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/skills/update.ts:26`: a CLI help example for `os skills update --version`. It pins a skills version on purpose and is not a spec version the server judges.
- Test fixtures and measurement notes in `packages/cli`, `packages/metadata-core`, `packages/qa/scenarios` and `packages/runtime` (`actions-refused-write-sentence-37533.test.ts`).
- `skills/objectstack-mcp-build/SKILL.md:15` (a compatibility statement, "none through 18.6.0 does") and `skills/objectstack-project/evals/project-process.json:74-75` (an eval prompt about an upgrade). Both are facts, not examples to copy, and they sit on a governed path (Prime Directive #14), so they are left alone. No follow-up is needed.

## Tests

- New case in `mcp-authoring.test.ts`: "the parameter description and the SemVer refusal give this server's own version as the example". It asserts that both texts contain `e.g. SERVER` (the resolved `@objectstack/spec` version) and do not contain `18.6.0`. No existing test pinned the old literal (the `'v18.6.0'` input in the SemVer-form case is an input value, and it is kept).
- Ablation: with `mcp-authoring.ts` restored from cac93cc6 on disk, the new case fails (`description: expected 'Recommended: …' to contain 'e.g. 19.0.0-next.0'`). With the fix restored, it passes.

<details><summary>Readings at de8f60aa</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 58 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/`: Test Files 242 passed, Tests 7072 passed, 4 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-server-runtime.authoring-scope.test.ts` (consumer of the door, after a runtime build): Tests 32 passed.
- Full `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` was narrowed to `src/domains/` because the whole package ran past the container's 10-minute foreground limit. CI's Test Core runs all of it.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 66 derived commands run, 64 exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone, positive-control commit not reachable) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, unbuilt dist) are NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 UNRUN.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/src/system/restriction-profile.zod.ts:249,253` describe the environment's reported spec and skills versions with "e.g. 18.4.0". That is spec prose for a field the environment reports, not a value an agent declares to this door, and editing it means regenerating the spec artifacts. It is noted here and not changed.

## Verification

Read first: `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts`, the `specVersionExample` helper and the two call sites (the template-literal escaping of the backticks is the riskiest part).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts -t "own version as the example"` should show 1 passed.
